Every density built from them: its weights (p₁, p₂, p₃), a point of the triangle
The followed point as a density over x
Setup: a density here is μ(x) = p₁b₁(x) + p₂b₂(x) + p₃b₃(x), where b₁, b₂, b₃ are Gaussian densities far enough apart not to overlap.
Left, the triangle of weights: corners, the basis densities (click one); draws μ₀ from P₀, where each path starts; its path under the learned field v*(μ, t) = 𝔼[μ̇t | μt = μ], ending at the outlined point μt, coloured by t; at t = 1 these points are generated draws from P₁; the field at the current t, where Pt has mass (pairs matched by optimal transport under the chosen geometry's distance, joined by its geodesics); the followed point (click one to follow it).
Right: the followed point, or a clicked corner, as a density over x, in the chosen geometry's colour.
